precise_scope: Enel 2019 issue; Cohuna/Kafireas 2023 pool replacement.
exact_claim: The Cohuna/Kafireas allocation exits follow deconsolidation after subsidiary-level stake sales while Enel retains joint control and economic interests.
needed_evidence: Transaction dates and entity-level stakes, project-to-subsidiary links, retained-control evidence, and an explicit connection between deconsolidation and allocation replacement.
available_evidence: Australia: 50% of two parent entities sold to INPEX on 29 September 2023; joint control retained. Cohuna vehicles show 50% Group holding at year-end. Hellas: 50% sold on 29 December 2023 with joint control retained; an official release links Kafireas to Hellas. The green report explicitly connects deconsolidation to EUR 156.86 million of 2019-issue reassignment.
source_locators: 2023 Green Bond Report p. 4; Annual Report 2023 pp. 235, 237 and 483; Kafireas issuer release 15 October 2019, opening paragraph.
inference_limit: The 50% sales concern Australian parent entities and Hellas, not verified direct 50% plant sales. Continued joint control is at subsidiary/JV level. verification_basis: Annual Report 2023 retained text pages 235, 237 and 483 were reviewed directly; project-subsidiary linkage and instrument provisions are supported by the shared verified commitment ledger.
